products.title: Rtulle & Satin
products.descriptionHtml:
Airy sweetness with a warm, glowing trail.

Rtulle & Satin is a 50 ml fragrance from the men’s line, presented in a clear cylindrical glass bottle with vivid turquoise liquid, a glossy black cap and silver collar, and a turquoise cylindrical presentation canister.

Size: 50 ml / 1.69 fl. oz.

Ingredients: Alcohol; Water (Aqua); Fragrance (Parfum); PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil; Propylene Glycol; Linalool; Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone; Citronellol; Geraniol; Coumarin; Benzyl Benzoate; Benzyl Alcohol; Limonene; Citral; Eugenol.

Care: Flammable; keep away from heat and open flame.
